reviewItem.question: For "fix(events): respect `--all-namespaces` flag by @mohiuddin-khan-shiam in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5414", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether operators run `flux events --all-namespaces` from the CLI (this is a client-side invocation that cluster manifests do not show)

proposed.statement: In Flux 2.7.0, the `flux events` CLI command now respects the `--all-namespaces` flag. This is a bugfix.
